verses.zh: 于是摩西下到百姓那里告诉他们。

verses.en: God spoke all these words, saying,
verses.zh: 神吩咐这一切的话说：

verses.en: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.zh: 「我是耶和华―你的神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。

verses.zh: 「除了我以外，你不可有别的神。

verses.en: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.zh: 「不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚么形像彷佛上天、下地，和地底下、水中的百物。

verses.zh: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华―你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；

verses.zh: 爱我、守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。

verses.zh: 「不可妄称耶和华―你神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。

verses.en: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.zh: 「当记念安息日，守为圣日。

verses.en: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
verses.zh: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，

verses.en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
verses.zh: 但第七日是向耶和华―你神当守的安息日。这一日你和你的儿女、仆婢、牲畜，并你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做；

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
verses.zh: 因为六日之内，耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物，第七日便安息，所以耶和华赐福与安息日，定为圣日。

words.g: and + to rest, i.e. settle down

verses.en: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
verses.zh: 「当孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和华―你神所赐你的地上得以长久。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: “You shall not murder.
verses.zh: 「不可杀人。

verses.zh: 「不可奸淫。

verses.en: “You shall not steal.
verses.zh: 「不可偷盗。

verses.en: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.zh: 「不可作假见证陷害人。

verses.zh: 「不可贪恋人的房屋；也不可贪恋人的妻子、仆婢、牛驴，并他一切所有的。」

verses.zh: 众百姓见雷轰、闪电、角声、山上冒烟，就都发颤，远远地站立，

verses.zh: 对摩西说：「求你和我们说话，我们必听；不要神和我们说话，恐怕我们死亡。」

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 摩西对百姓说：「不要惧怕；因为神降临是要试验你们，叫你们时常敬畏他，不致犯罪。」

verses.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你要向以色列人这样说：『你们自己看见我从天上和你们说话了。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
verses.zh: 你们不可做甚么神像与我相配，不可为自己做金银的神像。

verses.en: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
verses.zh: 你要为我筑土坛，在上面以牛羊献为燔祭和平安祭。凡记下我名的地方，我必到那里赐福给你。

words.g: requital, i.e. a  sacrifice in thanks + +you/your

verses.en: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
verses.zh: 你若为我筑一座石坛，不可用凿成的石头，因你在上头一动家具，就把坛污秽了。

verses.zh: 你上我的坛，不可用台阶，免得露出你的下体来。』」

verses.zh: 「你在百姓面前所要立的典章是这样：

verses.en: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
verses.zh: 你若买希伯来人作奴仆，他必服事你六年；第七年他可以自由，白白地出去。

verses.en: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.zh: 他若孤身来就可以孤身去；他若有妻，他的妻就可以同他出去。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.zh: 他主人若给他妻子，妻子给他生了儿子或女儿，妻子和儿女要归主人，他要独自出去。

verses.zh: 他的主人就要带他到审判官（或译：神；下同）那里，又要带他到门前，靠近门框，用锥子穿他的耳朵，他就永远服事主人。

verses.zh: 「人若卖女儿作婢女，婢女不可像男仆那样出去。

verses.zh: 主人选定她归自己，若不喜欢她，就要许她赎身；主人既然用诡诈待她，就没有权柄卖给外邦人。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 主人若选定她给自己的儿子，就当待她如同女儿。

verses.zh: 若另娶一个，那女子的吃食、衣服，并好合的事，仍不可减少。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 若不向她行这三样，她就可以不用钱赎，白白地出去。」

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 「打人以致打死的，必要把他治死。

verses.zh: 人若不是埋伏着杀人，乃是神交在他手中，我就设下一个地方，他可以往那里逃跑。

verses.zh: 人若任意用诡计杀了他的邻舍，就是逃到我的坛那里，也当捉去把他治死。

verses.zh: 「打父母的，必要把他治死。

verses.en: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.zh: 「拐带人口，或是把人卖了，或是留在他手下，必要把他治死。

verses.zh: 「咒骂父母的，必要把他治死。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 「人若彼此相争，这个用石头或是拳头打那个，尚且不至于死，不过躺卧在床，

verses.en: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
verses.zh: 若再能起来扶杖而出，那打他的可算无罪；但要将他耽误的工夫用钱赔补，并要将他全然医好。

to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish

verses.zh: 「人若彼此争斗，伤害有孕的妇人，甚至坠胎，随后却无别害，那伤害她的，总要按妇人的丈夫所要的，照审判官所断的，受罚。

verses.zh: 以烙还烙，以伤还伤，以打还打。

verses.zh: 「人若打坏了他奴仆或是婢女的一只眼，就要因他的眼放他去得以自由。

verses.en: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.zh: 若打掉了他奴仆或是婢女的一个牙，就要因他的牙放他去得以自由。」

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 「牛若触死男人或是女人，总要用石头打死那牛，却不可吃它的肉；牛的主人可算无罪。

verses.en: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
verses.zh: 倘若那牛素来是触人的，有人报告了牛主，他竟不把牛拴着，以致把男人或是女人触死，就要用石头打死那牛，牛主也必治死。

verses.zh: 牛无论触了人的儿子或是女儿，必照这例办理。

verses.zh: 牛若触了奴仆或是婢女，必将银子三十舍客勒给他们的主人，也要用石头把牛打死。

verses.zh: 「人若敞着井口，或挖井不遮盖，有牛或驴掉在里头，

verses.zh: 井主要拿钱赔还本主人，死牲畜要归自己。

verses.zh: 「这人的牛若伤了那人的牛，以至于死，他们要卖了活牛，平分价值，也要平分死牛。

words.g: and + to cut or split in two
to cut or split in two

verses.zh: 人若知道这牛素来是触人的，主人竟不把牛拴着，他必要以牛还牛，死牛要归自己。」

words.g: from + ago, i.e. a  time since

verses.zh: 「人若偷牛或羊，无论是宰了，是卖了，他就要以五牛赔一牛，四羊赔一羊。

verses.zh: 若太阳已经出来，就为他有流血的罪。贼若被拿，总要赔还。若他一无所有，就要被卖，顶他所偷的物。

used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 「人若在田间或在葡萄园里放牲畜，任凭牲畜上别人的田里去吃，就必拿自己田间上好的和葡萄园上好的赔还。

verses.zh: 「若点火焚烧荆棘，以致将别人堆积的禾捆，站着的禾稼，或是田园，都烧尽了，那点火的必要赔还。

verses.zh: 若找不到贼，那家主必就近审判官，要看看他拿了原主的物件没有。

used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.zh: 「两个人的案件，无论是为甚么过犯，或是为牛，为驴，为羊，为衣裳，或是为甚么失掉之物，有一人说：『这是我的』，两造就要将案件禀告审判官，审判官定谁有罪，谁就要加倍赔还。

verses.zh: 「人若将驴，或牛，或羊，或别的牲畜，交付邻舍看守，牲畜或死，或受伤，或被赶去，无人看见，

verses.zh: 要里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

words.g: and + from + separate by awall, i.e. outside
a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding

verses.en: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.zh: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。

verses.en: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.zh: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。

verses.en: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
verses.zh: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。

verses.en: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
verses.zh: 这杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。

verses.en: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
verses.zh: 必将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。

verses.en: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.zh: 要用精金做施恩座（施恩：或译蔽罪；下同），长二肘半，宽一肘半。

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.zh: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头。

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
verses.zh: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯要接连一块，在施恩座的两头。

words.g: and + a cherub or imaginary figure
the + a cherub or imaginary figure

verses.en: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
verses.zh: 二基路伯要高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要脸对脸，朝着施恩座。

words.g: the + a cherub or imaginary figure
to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward
the + a cherub or imaginary figure

verses.en: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
verses.zh: 要将施恩座安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。

words.g: from + to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
verses.zh: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从法柜施恩座上二基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。」

words.g: the + a cherub or imaginary figure

verses.en: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.
verses.zh: 「要用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半。

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit
and + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
verses.zh: 要包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

words.g: a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding

verses.en: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
verses.zh: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边。

words.g: {a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth
a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding
to + something enclosing, i.e. a margin + +him/his/it

verses.en: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
verses.zh: 要做四个金环，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四脚上的四角。

words.g: the + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.zh: 安环子的地方要挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。

words.g: the + something enclosing, i.e. a margin

verses.en: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
verses.zh: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。

verses.en: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
verses.zh: 要做桌子上的盘子、调羹，并奠酒的爵和瓶；这都要用精金制作。

words.g: to pour out, especially a libation

verses.en: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
verses.zh: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常摆陈设饼。」

verses.en: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
verses.zh: 「要用精金做一个灯台。灯台的座和干与杯、球、花，都要接连一块锤出来。

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
verses.zh: 灯台两旁要杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。

verses.en: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
verses.zh: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。

verses.en: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。

verses.en: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.zh: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球与枝子接连一块。灯台出的六个枝子都是如此。

verses.en: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.zh: 球和枝子要接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
verses.zh: 要做灯台的七个灯盏。祭司要点这灯，使灯光对照。

verses.en: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
verses.zh: 灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘也是要精金的。

words.g: and + a pan for live coals + +her/its

verses.en: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
verses.zh: 做灯台和这一切的器具要用精金一他连得。

words.g: a circle, i.e.  a circumjacent tract or region

verses.en: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
verses.zh: 要谨慎做这些物件，都要照着在山上指示你的样式。」

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.
verses.zh: 「你要用十幅幔子做帐幕。这些幔子要用捻的细麻和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

words.g: bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble
and + the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith

verses.en: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.zh: 每幅幔子要长二十八肘，宽四肘，幔子都要一样的尺寸。

words.g: in + a mother , i.e. a cubit
in + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
verses.zh: 这五幅幔子要幅幅相连；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相连。

verses.en: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做蓝色的钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也要照样做。

words.g: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
in + a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece

verses.en: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
verses.zh: 要在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都要两两相对。

words.g: in + a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece

verses.en: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.
verses.zh: 又要做五十个金钩，用钩使幔子相连，这才成了一个帐幕。

verses.en: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
verses.zh: 「你要用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。

words.g: a she-goat , but masculine in plural

verses.en: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
verses.zh: 每幅幔子要长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。

words.g: in + a mother , i.e. a cubit
in + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
verses.zh: 要把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅，这第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面摺上去。

verses.en: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也做五十个钮扣。

verses.en: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.zh: 又要做五十个铜钩，钩在钮扣中，使罩棚连成一个。

verses.en: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余那垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在帐幕的后头。

verses.en: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余长的，这边一肘，那边一肘，要垂在帐幕的两旁，遮盖帐幕。

words.g: and + the + a mother , i.e. a cubit
and + the + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.zh: 又要用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。

words.g: a  animal with fur, probably a species of antelope
from + to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
verses.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。

verses.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
verses.zh: 每块要长十肘，宽一肘半；

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit
the + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.zh: 每块必有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都要这样做。

verses.en: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
verses.zh: 帐幕的南面要做板二十块。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.zh: 在这二十块板底下要做四十个带卯的银座，两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。

verses.en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
verses.zh: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十块

words.g: and + to + a rib , literally  or figuratively
to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

verses.en: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
verses.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，要做板六块。

verses.en: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
verses.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角要做板两块。

verses.en: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.zh: 板的下半截要双的，上半截要整的，直顶到第一个环子；两块都要这样做两个拐角。

words.g: to be  twinned, i.e.  duplicate or  jointed
from + to + downward, below or beneath

verses.en: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.zh: 必有八块板和十六个带卯的银座；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

verses.en: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做闩：为帐幕这面的板做五闩，

verses.en: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
verses.zh: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩。

verses.en: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
verses.zh: 板腰间的中闩要从这一头通到那一头。

verses.en: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.zh: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金环套闩；闩也要用金子包裹。

verses.en: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.zh: 要照着在山上指示你的样式立起帐幕。

verses.en: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.
verses.zh: 「你要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

words.g: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
and + bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble

verses.en: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
verses.zh: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个带卯的银座上。

verses.en: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
verses.zh: 要使幔子垂在钩子下，把法柜抬进幔子内；这幔子要将圣所和至圣所隔开。

verses.en: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
verses.zh: 又要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上，

verses.en: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.
verses.zh: 把桌子安在幔子外帐幕的北面；把灯台安在帐幕的南面，彼此相对。

words.g: from + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.zh: 「你要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。

words.g: to + an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way
the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
and + bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble

verses.en: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
verses.zh: 要用皂荚木为帘子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上当有金钩；又要为柱子用铜铸造五个带卯的座。」

verses.en: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
verses.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做坛。这坛要四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。

verses.en: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
verses.zh: 要在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。

verses.en: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
verses.zh: 要做盆，收去坛上的灰，又做铲子、盘子、肉锸子、火鼎；坛上一切的器具都用铜做。

words.g: and + a pan for live coals + +him/his/it

verses.en: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
verses.zh: 要为坛做一个铜网，在网的四角上做四个铜环，

verses.en: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
verses.zh: 把网安在坛四面的围腰板以下，使网从下达到坛的半腰。

words.g: from + to + downward, below or beneath

verses.en: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.zh: 又要用皂荚木为坛做杠，用铜包裹。

verses.en: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
verses.zh: 这杠要穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛。

verses.en: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
verses.zh: 要用板做坛，坛是空的，都照着在山上指示你的样式做。」

verses.en: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
verses.zh: 「你要做帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用捻的细麻做帷子，长一百肘。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction
bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble
in + a mother , i.e. a cubit
to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.zh: 帷子的柱子要二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。

words.g: and + attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars + +them/their

verses.en: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.zh: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction
and + attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars + +them/their

verses.en: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.zh: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.zh: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.zh: 门这边的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

verses.en: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.zh: 门那边的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

verses.en: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.zh: 院子的门当有帘子，长二十肘，要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织成，柱子四根，带卯的座四个。

words.g: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith

verses.zh: 耶和华使他们的心满有智慧，能做各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和细麻、绣花的工，并机匠的工，他们都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。

in + the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
and + in + bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble

verses.en: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”
verses.zh: 「比撒列和亚何利亚伯，并一切心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐智慧聪明、叫他知道做圣所各样使用之工的，都要照耶和华所吩咐的做工。」

words.g: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites

verses.en: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
verses.zh: 凡耶和华赐他心里有智慧、而且受感前来做这工的，摩西把他们和比撒列并亚何利亚伯一同召来。

words.g: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites

verses.en: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
verses.zh: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为做圣所并圣所使用之工所拿来的礼物。百姓每早晨还把甘心献的礼物拿来。

words.g: the + a present , especially in sacrifice or as tribute

verses.en: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
verses.zh: 凡做圣所一切工的智慧人各都离开他所做的工，

verses.en: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”
verses.zh: 来对摩西说：「百姓为耶和华吩咐使用之工所拿来的，富富有余。」

words.g: from + enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases

verses.en: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.zh: 摩西传命，他们就在全营中宣告说：「无论男女，不必再为圣所拿甚么礼物来。」这样才拦住百姓不再拿礼物来。

words.g: to + a present , especially in sacrifice or as tribute
and + to restrict, by act  or word

verses.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
verses.zh: 因为他们所有的材料够做一切当做的物，而且有余。

words.g: enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases + +them/their
and + to jut over or exceed

verses.en: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
verses.zh: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帐幕。这幔子是比撒列用捻的细麻和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

words.g: bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble
and + the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith

verses.en: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
verses.zh: 每幅幔子长二十八肘，宽四肘，都是一样的尺寸。

words.g: in + a mother , i.e. a cubit
in + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
verses.zh: 他使这五幅幔子幅幅相连，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相连；

verses.en: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
verses.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做蓝色的钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也照样做；

words.g: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
in + a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece
in + a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece

verses.en: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
verses.zh: 在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都是两两相对；

words.g: in + a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece

verses.en: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
verses.zh: 又做五十个金钩，使幔子相连。这才成了一个帐幕。

verses.en: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
verses.zh: 他用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。

words.g: a she-goat , but masculine in plural

verses.en: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
verses.zh: 每幅幔子长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。

words.g: in + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.zh: 他把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅；

verses.en: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
verses.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也做五十个钮扣；

words.g: in + a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece

verses.en: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
verses.zh: 又做五十个铜钩，使罩棚连成一个；

verses.en: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.zh: 并用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖，再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。

words.g: a  animal with fur, probably a species of antelope
from + to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.zh: 他用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。

verses.en: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
verses.zh: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半；

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit
the + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
verses.zh: 每块有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都是这样做。

verses.en: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.zh: 帐幕的南面做板二十块。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.zh: 在这二十块板底下又做四十个带卯的银座：两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。

verses.en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
verses.zh: 帐幕的第二面，就是北面，也做板二十块

words.g: and + to + a rib , literally  or figuratively
to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个：这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

verses.en: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，做板六块。

verses.en: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
verses.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角做板两块。

verses.en: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
verses.zh: 板的下半截是双的，上半截是整的，直到第一个环子；在帐幕的两个拐角上都是这样做。

words.g: to be  twinned, i.e.  duplicate or  jointed
from + to + downward, below or beneath
to be  twinned, i.e.  duplicate or  jointed

verses.en: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
verses.zh: 有八块板和十六个带卯的银座，每块板底下有两卯。

verses.en: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.zh: 他用皂荚木做闩：为帐幕这面的板做五闩，

verses.en: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
verses.zh: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩，

verses.en: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.zh: 使板腰间的中闩从这一头通到那一头。

verses.en: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.zh: 用金子将板包裹，又做板上的金环套闩；闩也用金子包裹。

verses.en: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
verses.zh: 他用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

words.g: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
and + bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble

verses.en: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
verses.zh: 为幔子做四根皂荚木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金钩，又为柱子铸了四个带卯的银座。

verses.en: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
verses.zh: 拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘；

words.g: to + an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way
the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color  obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
and + bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble

verses.en: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
verses.zh: 又为帘子做五根柱子和柱子上的钩子，用金子把柱顶和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五个带卯的座，是铜的。

words.g: and + attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars + +them/their

verses.en: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.zh: 比撒列用皂荚木做柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。

words.g: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites
and + a mother , i.e. a cubit
and + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
verses.zh: 里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边，

words.g: and + from + separate by awall, i.e. outside
a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding

verses.en: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
verses.zh: 又铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上：这边两环，那边两环。

verses.en: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.zh: 用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。

verses.en: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.zh: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。

verses.en: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.zh: 用精金做施恩座，长二肘半，宽一肘半。

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
verses.zh: 用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头，

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
verses.zh: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯接连一块，在施恩座的两头。

words.g: and + a cherub or imaginary figure
the + a cherub or imaginary figure

verses.en: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
verses.zh: 二基路伯高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座；基路伯是脸对脸，朝着施恩座。

words.g: the + a cherub or imaginary figure
to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward
the + a cherub or imaginary figure

verses.en: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
verses.zh: 他用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半，

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit
and + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
verses.zh: 又包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

words.g: a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding

verses.en: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
verses.zh: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边，

words.g: {a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth
a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding
to + something enclosing, i.e. a margin + +him/his/it

verses.en: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
verses.zh: 又铸了四个金环，安在桌子四脚的四角上。

words.g: the + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.zh: 安环子的地方是挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。

words.g: the + something enclosing, i.e. a margin

verses.en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
verses.zh: 他用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子；

verses.en: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
verses.zh: 又用精金做桌子上的器皿，就是盘子、调羹，并奠酒的瓶和爵。

words.g: to pour out, especially a libation

verses.en: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
verses.zh: 他用精金做一个灯台；这灯台的座和干，与杯、球、花，都是接连一块锤出来的。

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
verses.zh: 灯台两旁杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。

verses.en: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.zh: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。

verses.en: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花。

verses.en: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
verses.zh: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球，与枝子接连一块；灯台杈出的六个枝子都是如此。

verses.en: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.zh: 球和枝子是接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。

words.g: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering

verses.en: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
verses.zh: 用精金做灯台的七个灯盏，并灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘。

words.g: and + a pan for live coals + +her/its

verses.en: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
verses.zh: 他用精金一他连得做灯台和灯台的一切器具。

words.g: a circle, i.e.  a circumjacent tract or region

verses.en: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
verses.zh: 他用皂荚木做香坛，是四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘，坛的四角与坛接连一块；

words.g: and + a mother , i.e. a cubit
and + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
verses.zh: 又用精金把坛的上面与坛的四面并坛的四角包裹，又在坛的四围镶上金牙边。

words.g: a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding

verses.en: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
verses.zh: 做两个金环，安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁、两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。

words.g: to + a chaplet , i.e.  a border moulding + +him/his/it

verses.en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.zh: 用皂荚木做杠，用金包裹。

verses.en: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
verses.zh: 又按做香之法做圣膏油和馨香料的净香。

verses.en: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
verses.zh: 他用皂荚木做燔祭坛，是四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，

verses.en: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
verses.zh: 在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。

verses.en: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
verses.zh: 他做坛上的盆、铲子、盘子、肉锸子、火鼎；这一切器具都是用铜做的。

words.g: the + a pan for live coals

verses.en: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
verses.zh: 又为坛做一个铜网，安在坛四面的围腰板以下，从下达到坛的半腰。

words.g: from + to + downward, below or beneath

verses.en: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
verses.zh: 为铜网的四角铸四个环子，作为穿杠的用处。

verses.en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.zh: 用皂荚木做杠，用铜包裹，

verses.en: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
verses.zh: 把杠穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛，并用板做坛；坛是空的。

verses.en: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.zh: 他用铜做洗濯盆和盆座，是用会幕门前伺候的妇人之镜子做的。

words.g: the + something round , i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking
a stand, i.e. pedestal or station + +him/his/it
an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.en: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
verses.zh: 他做帐幕的院子。院子的南面用捻的细麻做帷子，宽一百肘。

words.g: to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction
bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble
in + a mother , i.e. a cubit

verses.en: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.zh: 帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个；柱子上的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。

words.g: and + attached, i.e. a fence-rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars + +them/their

verses.en: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.zh: 北面也有帷子，宽一百肘。帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个；柱子上的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。

words.g: and + to + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.zh: 把洗濯盆安在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。

words.g: the + something round , i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking

verses.en: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
verses.zh: 又在四围立院帷，把院子的门帘挂上。

verses.en: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
verses.zh: 用膏油把帐幕和其中所有的都抹上，使帐幕和一切器具成圣，就都成圣。

words.g: and + to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint

verses.en: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
verses.zh: 又要抹燔祭坛和一切器具，使坛成圣，就都成为至圣。

words.g: and + to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint

verses.en: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
verses.zh: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使盆成圣。

words.g: and + to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint
the + something round , i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking
a stand, i.e. pedestal or station + +him/his/it

verses.en: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
verses.zh: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.en: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.zh: 要给亚伦穿上圣衣，又膏他，使他成圣，可以给我供祭司的职分；

words.g: and + to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint
and + to officiate as a priest

verses.en: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
verses.zh: 又要使他儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。

verses.en: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
verses.zh: 怎样膏他们的父亲，也要照样膏他们，使他们给我供祭司的职分。他们世世代代凡受膏的，就永远当祭司的职任。」

words.g: and + to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint
to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint
father, in a literal and immediate + +them/their
and + to officiate as a priest

verses.en: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
verses.zh: 摩西这样行，都是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

verses.en: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
verses.zh: 第二年正月初一日，帐幕就立起来。

verses.en: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
verses.zh: 摩西立起帐幕，安上带卯的座，立上板，穿上闩，立起柱子。

verses.en: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 在帐幕以上搭罩棚，把罩棚的顶盖盖在其上，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

words.g: from + to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
verses.zh: 又把法版放在柜里，把杠穿在柜的两旁，把施恩座安在柜上。

words.g: from + to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 把柜抬进帐幕，挂上遮掩柜的幔子，把法柜遮掩了，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

verses.en: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
verses.zh: 又把桌子安在会幕内，在帐幕北边，在幔子外。

words.g: from + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 在桌子上将饼陈设在耶和华面前，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

words.g: and + to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.zh: 又把灯台安在会幕内，在帐幕南边，与桌子相对，

verses.en: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 在耶和华面前点灯，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

verses.en: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
verses.zh: 把金坛安在会幕内的幔子前，

verses.en: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 在坛上烧了馨香料做的香，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

words.g: and + to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire

verses.en: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.zh: 又挂上帐幕的门帘。

words.g: the + an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.en: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 在会幕的帐幕门前，安设燔祭坛，把燔祭和素祭献在其上，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way

verses.en: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
verses.zh: 把洗濯盆安在会幕和坛的中间，盆中盛水，以便洗濯。

words.g: the + something round , i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking

verses.en: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
verses.zh: 摩西和亚伦并亚伦的儿子在这盆里洗手洗脚。

words.g: and + Aharon, the brother of Moses

verses.en: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.zh: 他们进会幕或就近坛的时候，便都洗濯，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。

verses.en: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
verses.zh: 在帐幕和坛的四围立了院帷，把院子的门帘挂上。这样，摩西就完了工。

words.g: and + to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
verses.zh: 当时，云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣光就充满了帐幕。

words.g: the + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
verses.zh: 摩西不能进会幕；因为云彩停在其上，并且耶和华的荣光充满了帐幕。

words.g: the + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
verses.zh: 每逢云彩从帐幕收上去，以色列人就起程前往；

words.g: the + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
to pull up, especially the tent-pins

verses.en: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
verses.zh: 云彩若不收上去，他们就不起程，直等到云彩收上去。

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
the + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
to pull up, especially the tent-pins

verses.en: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.zh: 日间，耶和华的云彩是在帐幕以上；夜间，云中有火，在以色列全家的眼前。在他们所行的路上都是这样。

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
